versions.description: A severed troll limb that moves, attacks, and can grow into a new troll.

sections.title: Traits
lines:
Regeneration. The limb regains 5 HP at the start of its turn. Acid or Fire damage stops this trait on its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn at 0 HP and does not regenerate.
Troll Spawn. A severed limb senses its surroundings as a whole troll would. If it survives 24 hours, roll a d12. On a 12 it becomes a Troll. On any other result, it withers away.

sections.title: Actions
lines: Rend. Melee attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.

sections.title: Severed by a troll
lines: A limb created by a Troll’s Loathsome Limbs trait appears in the troll’s space and takes its turn immediately after the troll.

sections.title: Habitats
lines: Arctic, Forest, Hill, Mountain, Swamp, Underdark.
